title: Bridging the Digital Divide: 25 Years of Empowerment in Panama
description: Cisco Networking Academy celebrates its 25-year presence in Panama. From partnering with indigenous communities to setting new educational standards for technical education, we’re bridging the country's digital divide one certification at a time.

title: Cisco Live Melbourne: What’s Happening at the Learn with Cisco Booth
